steps.name: Major Commentator
steps.text: Fifteen knights, fifteen chances to take first prize!

steps.name: Major Commentator
steps.text: Who's the Knight tonight?! Who are you betting on?! And who's going to walk out of the bloodbath with a handful of gold? Who'll stride through the storm to win our admiration?!

steps.name: Major Commentator
steps.text: We're ten minutes away from the official start of the match! Don't miss this chance to get filthy rich overnight! You'd only end up kicking yourself! Now let's witness the birth of a rising star!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: Do you need something?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: C'mon, drop the act for a minute. It's not every day you see a Zalak knight around here, so I'm just popping over to say hi, that's all.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Nervous?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: Are you... Infected too?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I mean, who wouldn't be? Only Infected would fight a match like this... our lives are a goddamned game here.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What'cha staring at me for? Spooky.

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: It's just... you seem a little... familiar.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmm? Trying to cozy up to me?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: No. Maybe you're right about Zalak knights... being pretty uncommon.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Well, since life's bundled us together, how about we team up?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: Quit playing around. I'm in this to—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: To give the knight nobility a little hands-on knock-knock?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: ...How do you...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Got it in your eyes.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It's too obvious. There's disdain, there's anger, and they've been your bywords for a little too long—those couple of bigshot knights up in the stands, they're beginning to notice you, y'know?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: This place isn't worth that.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Don't jump to conclusions, okay... take a look around. What are the different kinds of Infected knights around here?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Some bought up by the big shots as a little gambling pastime. There's a share in it for them if they make it, and if they lose, hoo boy, let's not get into that.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Of course, you've got some anonymous nobodies, thirsty for a real-ass high-riding knight or some merchant to pick them out. Thirsty to become... a tool.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: They've got no other way. Infected never get any other way.

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: What are you getting at?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: C'mon. Let's team up, okay?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Your chances in a melee, see, they're always better with a little personal alliancing, y'know?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: So why do you want to win, then? For the prize money?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No. Because I can't let anyone else win.

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: —The hell.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: There's something going on behind this match. A couple Infected... I'm not too sure yet, but my worry's they've 'settled on it,' so to speak.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: They've decided to trample the others, haul themselves on up, for better odds of survival.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The only real choice, right? Too real for plenty here to not be thinking it.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: —That's why I can't let them win. If someone wins, someone loses. Big whoop. But if someone's living, then... someone's dying.

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: A vague sense of justice isn't gonna win you much trust.

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: But—sure. Right now is make-or-break for Knights Association approval...

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: I'm in. Zalak and Zalak. Beats teaming with some rando any day.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Eh? For real?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: If you just came over to screw with me, then I'm gonna start with you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, no, I'm real. Let's take this melee together, Ashley.

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: Greynuty Kaliska.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...Kaliska...?

steps.name: An Indifferent Knight
steps.text: Joke of a surname. Just pretend you don't know, even if you've heard it before.

steps.name: Major Commentator
steps.text: Now! Let's welcome—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You can call me Sona, Ashley.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Sona.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmm? What's up?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Back then, at the end, you took my points out of nowhere, didn't you?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...Ahaha... Ashley, c'mon... that was, uh...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: C'mon, are you still not over that?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Don't you think I might be a little stuck on it?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But not because you stole the crown from me.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You said you couldn't let anyone else win... and I was just the same.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What are you overreacting for? We'd only just met then. It's normal not to trust.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No, well... uh... actually, yeah...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Look, weren't we going to see how the Infected ghetto was doing? Let's move.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Allow me! To come up with an excuse! To restore our bonds of Knightclub trust—!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Since when were we in a Knightclub?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...Heh.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Since sooner or later, Ashley.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You mean... that Knightclub for Infected?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I came from around Victoria, if you're curious. Plenty of that sort of pine tree around, back when I was young. These days they're long gone, though.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Pinus sylvestris? Pinus... sylvestris...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You were one of those Zalaks who got hit by that Catastrophe?! You got left for dead by the knights too—the Kaliskas abandoned you...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Let it go, Ashley. It's bygone stuff.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But... then your infection was... my family's fault?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Didn'tcha already break from your family? They don't count as family anymore, then.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You're not feeling any guilt for me, not on my watch. Oh, right, weren't you just talking about how I stole your championship?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We're even.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: So you're... 'Flametail' Sona?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You know me, then.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Haha, not many Infected around who win knight titles. I know them all.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: So Pinus Sylvestris is led by the one and only 'Flametail' Sona... that puts me at ease, then.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You look after those kids?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I do. Er, but I only took them in... and a couple of them aren't Infected, actually. I was gonna send them to an aid station somewhere.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: So I can't come along for the ride. Sorry, Flametail.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Can I get your name, at least?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Jamie. Call me Jamie.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Jamie, then. You said you know a couple Infected knights?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Every Infected keeping up the independent fight is an ally in waiting.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I remember one making a big splash lately... a Liberi, a sniper.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You're right, and there's a Kuranta... she's 'Leader' to a couple Infected knights, and to others, 'Wild Mane.'

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: ...*Spit*.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yo, Iwona. Tired?

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: Hey there, Sona.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: You, uh... seem pretty smooth rolling, still. Strong stuff.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Not really. Just... always gotta keep up some of the lax act.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: You tired too? Didn't know you felt it. Figured you were always like that, on the forward march.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha...

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: Hah. That proves you trust me, though. Looking that beat in front of me.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: So, this, uh... Armorless Union biz. How do we deal with 'em?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Do everything we can to keep them from knowing where exactly the Infected are settled.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: So long as they hide in the city, an Infected's got nowhere to go.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: We'll get found sooner or later, Sona. This isn't gonna solve anything.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: You need to think of some way—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmm.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: —Nah, maybe we oughtn'ta dump everything on your back. I'm sorry.

steps.name: A Wild Knight
steps.text: Yeah, chewing over stuff like this isn't my style, but you oughtn'ta run your own load too heavy, Sona. We're here for you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmm!

steps.name: A Spectating Knight A
steps.text: She's an Infected, isn't she? How'd she get so many points...?

steps.name: A Spectating Knight B
steps.text: Not just that, Night of Knights had a whole spread for her interview a few days ago!

steps.name: A Spectating Knight A
steps.text: They either take underground fights for money, or uncompenasted battles just to get a title from the Association. How do Infected like her even survive?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: So that's Justyna?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: She looks frail as a twig. Where's the skill?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You ever hear the one about books and covers?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But the papers haven't, uh... been duly proper to her lately.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: How many times have they ever been proper to Infected?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Actually, forget Infected. When have the media ever cared about being fair to anyone?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Can we believe anything that Armorless goon said?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: It's something to go off. Beats having no ideas at all.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What's our plan?

steps.name: A Spectating Knight
steps.text: That's what I'm talking about—Justyna! Get that Feather Knight!

steps.name: A Spectating Knight
steps.text: To the left! Behind the stone bunker! Yeah! That's it—no, no! Don't peek out, you'll be clocked—nooo!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: She's pretty popular, huh.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Might not wanna join us?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: If she keeps doing what she's doing, she'll be titled sooner or later. Make a killing riding the wave of popularity, and maybe she can go find somewhere quiet to live out her days.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: If she's that kind of Infected, can we really talk them into helping us?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We can't talk anyone over.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But this city forces Infected to make a choice in the end.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Honestly, it might just force everyone.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I hardly ever see you this pessimistic.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You're the one who asked!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I'm here hoping the Flametail Knight'll declare to me 'no problem, it's all under control.'

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...haha.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No problem... it's all under control.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Still not certain.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Besides, it's still ambiguous how the Adeptus treat Infected.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: How would any of those knight families give a thought for the Infected?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We're just outsiders to them. They'd never let us get away.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No matter how arrogant they are, I'd still take five hundred of them over the K.G.C.C. Dumb shameless assholes.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You've got a soft spot for campaign knights.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha, they're the knights who fought Ursus off the grasslands! Tops clowns on stage winning points with the audience any day!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Ursus. All I know of them is the news I saw when I was young...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ursus lost their war with Higashi. Of course the knights cranked up the publicity machine.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You... know about the war between Ursus and Higashi too?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, they forced me to read a dead tree or two when I was young. It was all stuff on the modern history of the campaign knights.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I can't imagine it.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Iwona sitting at a table, holding a book. It's too farfetched. Inconceivable.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You're from a campaign knight family, I think?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Studying's not... outta the question... for you, I guess, haha...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Keh! Is this how you all see me?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ten years after the Tenth Kazimierz-Ursus War, the Emperor of Ursus got seriously sick, and everything annexed from Kazimierz fell into the nobles' hands.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The crown prince picked up on the corruption inside the military even before succession, goading two Armies to rise up, as a distraction.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No way the Ursus nobles could ever agree on one plan, but they were all born and raised in this nation of chaos. They sent their own forces out against Higashi without any argument, so they could cover up their own crimes...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Which led to Higashi launching an attack of their own on Ursus far beyond what anyone expected, and in the end, the decisive battle took place inside Ursus territory.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Jeez. Didn't know you had straight history lectures in you, Iwona.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No clarification on those bits that obviously got mixed in.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: At that point in Kazimierz, a good deal of the knights thought they should strike while Ursus was up to their ears in it, and in all the unrest, they'd take back the cities they lost ten years ago...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...and that was 1072. 25 years ago.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: My grandparents were there with the scouts who resisted Ursus, only to get strangled by the Army before they could really rise up. I wish I got to know them.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, don't take it so hard. That's the past. I'm not a campaign knight anymore, so I jump when you say jump, Sona.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Enough about me. Let's talk your plans now.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: This morning, Jamie got three, maybe four new Infected in on his end.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Miners, infected in a small industrial accident, but the contractor declined to reimburse their medical fees, so with nowhere to go, they ended up with the police out for them.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And that's not the end... we've had over ten normal Infected join us this month already, right?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: They live in the darkest, dankest corners of the Grand Knight Territory... we've got no way to settle them.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Sona.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We've still got time. We've got power. We'll find a way.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But... I won't... let any innocent Infected end up risking themselves with us.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If the Adeptus really will let us all have legal identities again, live on in Kazimierz, then—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: —Man, this is some party.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Flametail Knight, Sona.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You are suspected of illegally harboring Infected, publicly violating the Knights Association's code of conduct. Put an end to your resistance.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Hand over the illegal Infected, and we will report your case to the Knights Association.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Musta missed this. Armorless have authority to help settle biz for the police and knights now?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Let's all be honest. Don't you guys feel ashamed when you use the law as this big pompous excuse?

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Your provocations will get you nowhere, Flametail Knight.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You have already overstepped the mark. Here in the Grand Knight Territory, drawing the Chamber's gaze is tantamount to death.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Death? That's some scary stuff there.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: A biological death is not death's only sense, Flametail Knight.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: The more chances for survival Kazimierz accords us, the more deaths it creates for us down the line.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: All hands, take aim!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: —Shelling from the rear?!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona! I'm here!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: It's backup from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub! Surround them!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Justyna!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Roger. Laying cover fire.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sorry, Sona, I'm going in!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Do Infected cry?

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Infected. I don't mean the knights who had the guts to resist the Chamber. I mean all the normal Infected.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: They just got Oripathy, right?

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Er... yes?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: They're not monsters. And they're not scum of the earth either.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'm not all that into this assignment.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Don't ever let the Lazurites hear you say that!

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: But still, have you found some sort of compassion for them, Platinum?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Huh. Compassion... not really, I guess. I don't even get the time for myself, after all.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Compassion's a luxury kinda deal these days.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I've got other assignments. Dealing with the Infected is pretty small-time. You guys have it.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: It doesn't matter what tantrums Adeptus throws at the K.G.C.C., neither's gonna wanna keep Infected in the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The nobles aren't gonna care whether Infected live or die, are they?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...How the...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Flametail!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: It's the Armorless... the Armorless suddenly attacked us!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Stay calm. What went down?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: They sealed off the street nearby two hours ago. We were busted long ago. And then they... used gas to force us out of the houses...!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: A few knights picked up on it. They used their own bodies to block the Armorless's shots, but some still...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Where...?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Where do we go next? If the Armorless Union got us the first time, they'll get us the second, the third... we...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Save the eulogies. First, we need to... move the rest of the Infected.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Should we get out of the Grand Knight Territory? Go somewhere in the countryside...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: At least! At least get the Infected civilians out of here—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We've been leaning on our knighthood so hard to give them some kind of cover.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: When there's no knighthood involved, when they're out of the Grand Knight Territory, it's only gonna get worse for them...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: So we just... take it?! We give up and accept this?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...The Adeptus.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We still have... that on the table, don't we.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: How was it?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I was dealing with an old knight... Definitely one of the Adeptus higher-ups, no doubt about it.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Best we don't trust the Grand Knight Territory nobles too hard, Sona.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It was Demian... vice-president of the Knights Association.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ha, there's a big guy for you. VP Demian, the renowned campaign knight.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I remember him. Huge ruckus for the news when he was discharged and came back to the Territory to do boring old civil service.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: A descendant of the heroes, like that one Maria girl.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: And the conditions...?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: If you're back here, that means there's been actual headway, correct? What conditions did the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi set?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: A separation. A Great Separation.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He wants to borrow our efforts... to put this city... to sleep.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Uh. What's that mean?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's how the plan goes, roughly.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We can do this... right?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Are you asking me?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Maybe. I'm not giving up until I see those dumb knight nobles bowing to me.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You guys?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Real simple plan. We fail if we're not strong enough. We get even stronger next time, we're good.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Long as we don't die, yeah?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Relax. Uncoil, don't get nervous.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris just needs to stay Pinus Sylvestris... and we'll be fine.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Whether or not we succeed, we only have one way open to us. There's no difference, really.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...Difference, huh.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You've been zoning out a lot lately. What's wrong?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Nah... nothing, really.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Let's go. We've gotta find a place for the Infected, still.
Run away... hurry!
Away from the sawdust... fire everywhere... chokes your sinuses... the soil's too hot to touch...
Ore... Originium... gashing...
The Kaliskas abandoned their subjects—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Did I... fall asleep? On a bench?)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley'd be on my case again if she was sitting here.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Lot of people... out on the street.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Infected under the Knights Association's supervision aren't allowed to walk around freely.)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (If all these pedestrians... knew there was an Infected out in broad moonlight here, I wonder what they'd think?)
Without knowing why, a thought flits through Sona's mind.
'They wouldn't think much.'
Pedestrians bustle, coming and going as life demands, melting together under the rainbow lights.
The Zalak called 'Flametail' silently watches the city before her.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hm? Oh, hey, it's Ashley. What's up—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Trouble! Sona, they found the underground shelter!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We're not gonna make it in time to move everyone! Whoever we save, we save! Hurry, get back—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: This is an Infected...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Right here!
